invented_facts: The 30B model 'required 128 GB memory for meaningful performance'; the tested 64 GB Vantage Pro 16 reached 15 tokens/second.
'Competitors' implies more than one comparison system was tested.
Sustained runs were '~10–12% slower'; the paper reports about 12% for Aurora 14 and 9% for Vantage Pro 16.
notes: The summary is concise and VP-oriented, but it omits required caveats that only one Vantage configuration was tested and that models were 4-bit quantized with output quality unevaluated. It also leaves out test conditions including the environment, power mode, and workload setup.
